name: Oppai Igai ga Dame Sugiru Ane
original_name: おっぱい以外がダメすぎる姉
source:
Although the protagonist doesn't have any special characteristics, his skill in home economics only, is very high. To say nothing of just cooking, his skill in doing all the household chores is unimaginable for a student. Rumor of him being a skilled housewife was spread from his friends from class. The reason for protagonist becoming like this was due to the 3 hopeless sisters who lived with him.

The eldest daughter, Kanako is the homeroom teacher of the protagonist. She is adored by her students as well. However, inside the home, she lives with a sloppy figure with only wearing underwear. Not only cooking, but is hopeless with every household chores.

The second daughter, Yume who is a neat and clean, kind nurse who is heavily relied upon by the patients and doctors alike in the hospital. Loves to drink alcohol. After getting drunk, approaches her younger brother in an indecent manner, taking her clothes off.

The third daughter, Hinori who is the student council president. An intellectual student who has top grades and has lots of trust from her teachers. However in reality, is a very jealous person and becomes sullen if she doesn't get attention from her brother.

With such bad sisters, a new problem happened during this spring.

The sisters contracted a disease "Cleopatra Syndrome" which involves a love addiction and heavy dependence on their younger brother. The protagonist was told from  the doctor that the only cure to this illness is "younger brother's sperm". "Can you do such things with your sister...?", while the protagonist being bewildered with thoughts like these, the 3 sisters started approaching him to take advantage of this situation.

However, because of exceeding the limits of his body due to excessive self indulgence in addition to his normal life, the brother started resisting. Therefore, his sister made a proposal "You can take advantage of our breasts as much as you like."

Relieving the stress accumulated from his sisters every day... Above all, being charmed by the benefit of being able to do as much as he pleases to the huge breasts of his sisters, which they show in the every day life, the protagonist accepted the proposal.

But that was a strategy made by the sisters to cross the line with the brother, they liked very much! 

And the curtain opens with the flirting and erotic happenings of the younger brother who is being manipulated by his no-good sisters---

translation:
主角虽然没有什么特殊之处，但光是家政方面的功夫，就非常高了。更不用说做饭了，他包揽所有家务的能力对于一个学生来说是难以想象的。他是一位熟练的家庭主妇的谣言是从他的班上朋友那里传出来的。主角之所以会变成这样，是因为和他一起生活的三个绝望的姐妹。

大女儿加奈子是主人公的班主任。她也深受学生的喜爱。然而，在家里，她却以只穿内衣的邋遢身材生活。不仅做饭，连家务活都无能为力。

二女儿梦，是一位干净整洁、善良的护士，深受医院患者和医生的信赖。喜欢喝酒。喝醉后，以不雅的方式接近弟弟，脱掉她的衣服。

三女儿，学生会长日织。成绩优秀、深受老师信任的知识分子学生。但实际上，她是一个嫉妒心很强的人，如果得不到哥哥的关注就会变得闷闷不乐。

有了这样的坏姐妹，今年春天又出现了新的问题。

姐妹俩患有“克利奥帕特拉综合症”，这种疾病涉及爱情成瘾和对弟弟的严重依赖。医生告诉主角，治愈这种病的唯一方法就是“弟弟的精子”。“你能和你的妹妹做这种事吗……？”，当主角被这样的想法困惑时，三姐妹开始接近他，以利用这种情况。

然而，由于在正常生活之外过度的自我放纵，超出了身体的极限，哥哥开始反抗。于是，妹妹提出了“你可以尽情利用我们的乳房”。

缓解每天从姐姐身上累积的压力……最重要的是，主角被每天都能展现出的姐姐们的巨乳所带来的好处所吸引，接受了求婚。

但这是姐妹们为了和哥哥越界而采取的策略，她们很喜欢！

然后，被不良姐妹们操纵的弟弟的调情和情色事件拉开了序幕——
